description: This Java class 'MessageHelper' provides utility methods for working with AMQP 1.0 messages, including property accessors, payload handling, message creation, and annotation management within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: MessageHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for manipulating AMQP messages, including property access, payload handling, message creation, and annotation management.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID from the message's application properties.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant ID from the message's application properties.

methods.name: getRegistrationAssertion
methods.description: Retrieves the registration assertion from the message's application properties.

methods.name: getAndRemoveRegistrationAssertion
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the registration assertion from the message's application properties.

methods.name: getDeviceIdAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID annotation from the message.

methods.name: getTenantIdAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant ID annotation from the message.

methods.name: getApplicationProperty
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve a typed application property by name.

methods.name: getJsonPayload
methods.description: Parses the message payload into a JSON object.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the payload bytes from the message body.

methods.name: getPayloadAsString
methods.description: Retrieves the payload as a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: addTenantId
methods.description: Adds tenant ID to message application properties.

methods.name: addDeviceId
methods.description: Adds device ID to message application properties.

methods.name: addRegistrationAssertion
methods.description: Adds registration assertion to message application properties.

methods.name: addCacheDirective
methods.description: Adds cache control directive to message application properties.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Retrieves cache control directive from message application properties.

methods.name: setTimeToLive
methods.description: Sets the TTL (time-to-live) of the message.

methods.name: addTimeUntilDisconnect
methods.description: Adds a 'time until disconnect' property to the message.

methods.name: getTimeUntilDisconnect
methods.description: Retrieves the 'time until disconnect' property.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status code from the message.

methods.name: addStatus
methods.description: Adds a status code to the message.

methods.name: addProperty
methods.description: Adds a generic property to the message's application properties.

methods.name: rejected
methods.description: Rejects and settles a message with an optional error condition.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds annotations to a message based on a resource identifier.

methods.name: addJmsVendorProperties
methods.description: Adds JMS vendor properties to the message if present.

methods.name: addAnnotation
methods.description: Adds an annotation key-value pair to the message.

methods.name: getAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves an annotation value by key and type.

methods.name: setCreationTime
methods.description: Sets the creation time of the message to the current timestamp.

methods.name: isDeviceCurrentlyConnected
methods.description: Determines if a device is currently connected based on creation time and TTD.

methods.name: setJsonPayload
methods.description: Sets the message payload to a JSON object with application/json content type.

methods.name: setPayload
methods.description: Sets the message payload with specified content type.

methods.name: hasDataBody
methods.description: Checks if the message body is a Data section.

methods.name: hasAmqpValueBody
methods.description: Checks if the message body is an AmqpValue section.

methods.name: getShallowCopy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of a message.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID or message ID for correlation.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a new AMQP message with specified properties and payload.

methods.name: addProperties
methods.description: Adds Hono-specific properties to a message, including annotations and application properties.

methods.name: addDefaults
methods.description: Adds default properties to a message, respecting TTL caps and content type.
